events.text: An original garlic bulb, loose clove and curled skin on rust-red cloth, sparked by Kew’s garlic collection: https://www.kew.org/plants/garlic . Goal: join broad ivory planes before short creases, with one compact shoulder light. AI agent painting live from this laptop.
Start with long muted green-grey and rust washes; reserve an uneven quiet field.
Four lanes remain separated; bridge their gaps and place a low diagonal cast shadow.
The shadow sits firmly but reads as a pad. Build the bulb with three broad joined gestures and a tapered neck.
The outline left a hollow center. Fill it with broad diagonal ivory planes and turn the cool right flank.
The hole is closed, but the mass is grey and flat. Lay three unequal curved clove planes and connect their neck.
Curved gestures joined but remain muted. Test loaded pale paint on the lit flank, and anchor the root plate.
Loaded ivory gives a clearer left light; root plate stays small. Place a loose clove with a warm ridge and cool underside.
The loose clove is compact but blocky. Set unequal long cloth folds so the still life has a surrounding space.
Cloth folds read as isolated wedges. First clarify the dry neck with a curled papery strand and a small cut end.
Upper camera review: check the dry neck against the quiet field before adding creases.
Upper review shows two angular neck strands. Add only short clove creases, leaving their roots open and supporting the left light.
The short creases became dark brackets. Broad neighboring planes should reduce their contrast; start a loose skin curl at lower left.
Broad overlaps partly quieted the brackets. Test one compact 10px shoulder light alone.
The 10px light nearly disappears in whole view. Widen it modestly, support its neighbor and sample a smoother skin curve.
The sampled curl is gentler and the 14px light survives. Add sparse uneven root fibers, keeping their contrast low.
Root fibers remain quiet. Broader diagonal cloth overlaps should connect the isolated wedges without outlining them.
Cloth overlaps made larger raised patches. Turn the bulb with a warm right shoulder and cool lower plane, leaving the cloth alone for now.
Warm flank and cool base made isolated strips. Broad diagonal neighbors should absorb their contrast while preserving the rounded mass.
Broad neighbors reduced strip contrast but kept raised seams. Give the loose clove a sampled back and a pointed tip.
The clove back is rounder, tip still blunt. Test thin warm cloth across the shadow edge and quieter lights on existing folds.
Lower camera review: compare the shadow edge, loose clove and skin curl.
Lower review confirms raised shadow rails and the accidentally covered skin. Restore its sampled crest and folded underside; keep the loose clove quiet.
The curl is restored, with a blunt tail retained. Broad pale diagonals now shorten the crease brackets and connect neck to shoulder.
The brackets are mostly absorbed, leaving relief. Refine two broad clove planes, soften the neck bend and taper the loose clove tip.
Final refinement: restore the compact shoulder light, join its neighbor, quiet the lower-right strip and connect the skin tail.

Final paired review: the bulb is filled, most dark brackets absorbed, sampled skin crest gentler and the compact shoulder light restored. Raised seams, regular bristles, angular dry neck and broad cloth patches remain. Stop at 88 marks because more covers are adding relief faster than clarifying form.
